freshTransferCandidates.contrast: Ordered actions in a classroom instead of a street route.
A closed shop and an appointment date instead of a friend's availability.
An assigned household job instead of a picnic contribution.
A stationery unit price instead of a fruit price; no calculation.
Train arrival versus a later meeting instead of film start versus an earlier meeting.
An indoor drying place instead of a study seat; adjacent weather context is new.

imageTrial.brief: A neutral classroom layout with an entrance and matching unmarked shelves on both sides, no books being moved, no notebooks, people, arrows or highlighted route.
imageTrial.check: The selected shelf's right/left relation must still come from audio; no first/next task may be inferred from the scene.

imageTrial.brief: A neutral reception seating area showing entrance chairs, a window chair, a counter and an outside-door waiting spot; no umbrella, people, clocks, arrows or highlighting.
imageTrial.check: Each location alternative remains visually possible; the lost umbrella's appearance, past position and closing time require audio.

publication.finalListeningApproval: Owner explicitly selected 'Approved all remaining 18 after listening, including the revised bakery' on 2026-10-24, after the complete-package review request including classroom teacher/library borrower role fit. This approves the exact replacement Nanami bakery recording and the other 17 final-batch recordings, not the superseded Aoi bakery audio. It records the listener declaration, not independent or automated linguistic certification.
publication.limits: No physical-device import/playback has been observed. Coverage counts are editorial breadth, not measured transfer or an official N5 completeness claim.
publication.scope: 24 new passages/72 questions, 24 exact approved recordings and two accepted contextual images enabled in local runtime. Original twelve passage/audio files unchanged.

changesDuringAuthoring: Removed unnecessary conditional なら and たら, and a 今日のうちに phrase, rather than increasing grammar load to fill tasks.
Simplified the photo collection slip request without adding a scored honorific expression.
Separated people, planned versus completed actions, proposal versus final choice, and meeting time versus event time in the intended keys.
Changed the banana question from a take-along count to a total request, matching one eaten now and one at school.
Made the umbrella pickup's evening hour explicit and translated 面白い as entertaining rather than restricting it to comedy.
Context-image candidates were inspected against every option; both matching classroom shelves and all reception location alternatives stay unselected. No scored target object is drawn.

Owner-reported bakery parent timbre was resolved by changing only customer voice Aoi to Nanami. The owner then approved all remaining 18 exact recordings including role-fit checks; the original six approvals were preserved.
review.method: Direct author review of complete scripts, translations, questions and all authored option rationales; not independent review.
